minutes_text:
CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 North Rexford Drive
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210
  Video Teleconference
  Beverly Hills City Council Liaison / City Website Steering Committee Meeting

  SPECIAL MEETING HIGHLIGHTS

  Tuesday, March 26, 2024
  4:30 PM

MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time:  March 26, 2024 / 4:30 PM
IN ATTENDANCE:  Councilmember Lili Bosse, Councilmember John Mirisch, Deputy City
  Manager Keith Sterling, Public Information Manager Lauren Santillana,
  Chief Information Officer David Schirmer

  1) Public Comment:

  None

  2) Presentation from Civic Plus:
  a. Most of the information on the current website has migrated over to the new
  website, it is now up to the departments to refine and ensure the recency of the
  information.
  b. The full website will be brought to the full Council in mid-April. If it is approved, the
  website will launch at the end of the month.
  c. The top headers are fixed but the rest of the home page dynamically changes to
  fit the dimensions of the device using it.
  d. Councilmemebr Bosse would like for users of the website to be able to easily
  access live meetings from the Agendas and Live Meetings icon.
  e. Lauren Santillana proposed that there be an upcoming events section on the home
  page that would show upcoming events and remind residents to sign up for Nixle
  alerts and PD alerts.
  f. The liaisons indicated their preference for the blue boxes on the website to show
  current and upcoming events, not just popular links.
  g. The alert module will put an icon at the top bar of the screen that will provide a one
  click link to the meeting from any part of the site.
  h.

  3) Discussion:
  a. The Deputy City Manager gave a statement thanking Councilmember Bosse for
  all of her work over her years of service and that she will be missed.
 Highlights for March 26, 2024
City Website Steering Committee

  4) Adjournment:
  Date / Time: March 26, 2024 / 5:07 PM
